**Author:** Andrew O'Connell, CFA, FRM (@realpristinecap, verified; position trader; 3× US Investing Championship top-10 2023–2025; Substack pristinecapital.net; 33.4k followers) · posted 2026-09-01 13:52Z · received 2026-09-02T08:43:22Z (WhatsApp via RDP-30, routed by CoS).

## Summary
Thread-starter tweet promoting his 7-indicator "Techno-Fundamental Suite" now live on TradingView via the Creator Program (3 indicators free, 4 premium, $25/mo subscribable space — no separate checkout). Quote-tweets his own acceptance announcement into the Creator Program.

The capture-worthy core is the **top-down workflow taxonomy** the suite encodes:

1. **Follow global money flows** (macro liquidity/positioning first)
2. **Trade Market Profile levels** (structure: value areas, POC, excess)
3. **Confirm fundamentals** (techno-*fundamental*: validate the setup)
4. **Screen every signal** through the suite before acting

Credibility framing: audited USIC returns of +103.5%, +254.0%, +39.1% (2023–2025), CFA charterholder + FRM.

Stats at capture: 53.7k views, 332 likes, **806 bookmarks** (save-rate 2.4× likes — unusually high reference intent), 45 RTs, 7 replies.

**Thread caveat:** the per-indicator breakdown lives in the thread replies, which fxtwitter does not expose; only the quoted announcement was embedded. The 7 indicators themselves are NOT captured here — only the workflow skeleton and context.

## Why it matters
- A compact statement of the **top-down** school: macro flows → Market Profile structure → fundamental confirmation → systematic screening. Direct counterpoint to the vault's bottom-up cluster of simple, fully-specified systems — the two meet at the screening/validation stage.
- **First Market Profile note in the vault** — starts a structure/market-profile thread (value-area trading, TPO) previously absent.
- The 806-bookmark/332-like ratio marks this as save-for-later reference material for its audience, not engagement bait — but note the framing is a **product launch**: returns are cited by the promoter himself, attached to a paid suite. Standard skepticism gates apply (self-reported even if "audited", survivorship in contest formats, incentive to flatter the workflow his product sells).
- Distribution-model signal: TradingView Creator Program ($25/mo in-platform indicator spaces) is consolidating indie indicator distribution — context for any future tooling choice.
